newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European air traffic in Sept up 6 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: European air traffic in Sept up 6 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Major European airlines carried six percent more passengers in September than they did in the same month last year, a "normal" month in a year of highs and lows, the Association of European Airlines said on Monday.

Routes linking Europe to Far East and Australian destinations posted 7.3 percent passenger growth for September compared with 4.3 percent for intra-European flights and 4.7 percent on north Atlantic ones, the AEA said in a statement.
The year to date has produced a succession of high and low monthly growth figures, said the AEA, which represents most of the region's major flag carrying airlines.

Load factors, which inducate the number of seats occupied by fare-paying passengers, dipped slightly below September 1995 figures on all routes bar those for Far East routes, where they rose 0.9 percentage points to 78.3 percent.
